# 1. Imperial Co-Emperor Designation (Symbasileus / Co-Rulership Succession)
oe_dyn2_imperial_co_emperor = {
	include_ruler_siblings = yes
	through_female = yes
	allow_female = yes
	allow_children = yes
	ignore_ruler = yes
	traverse_family_tree = yes

	allowed_estates = { nobles_estate }
	heir_is_allowed = { }

	potential = {
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
		OR = {
			country_rank = country_rank:rank_empire
			has_or_had_tag = BYZ
			has_or_had_tag = ROM
			has_variable = oe_dyn2_co_emperor_charter
		}
		NOR = {
			succession_law = heir_selection:fratricide_succesion
			succession_law = heir_selection:unigeniture
		}
	}

	allowed = {
		stability >= 15
	}

	modifier = {
		monthly_legitimacy = 0.04
		appoint_as_heir_price_cost_modifier = -0.25
	}

	succession_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:new_ruler
				scope:new_ruler = { is_adult = yes }
			}
			add_legitimacy = 8
			add_stability = 5
		}
	}

	sibling_score = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = root }
			add = {
				desc = "HEIR_SELECTION_ADM_DESC"
				value = root.adm
			}
			add = {
				desc = "HEIR_SELECTION_DIP_DESC"
				value = root.dip
			}
			add = {
				desc = "HEIR_SELECTION_MIL_DESC"
				value = root.mil
			}
			add = {
				desc = "HEIR_SELECTION_APPOINTED_HEIR_DESC"
				if = {
					limit = { has_character_modifier = appoint_as_heir_modifier }
					value = 250
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "HEIR_SELECTION_BORN_IN_THE_PURPLE_DESC"
				if = {
					limit = { modifier:byz_born_in_the_purple = yes }
					value = 120
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "HEIR_SELECTION_OLDER_HEIR_DESC"
				value = character_age
			}
			add = {
				desc = "HEIR_SELECTION_IS_UNSUITED_TO_RULE_DESC"
				if = {
					limit = { modifier:blocked_from_being_ruler = yes }
					value = -1000
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			add = { desc = "HEIR_SELECTION_ADM_DESC" value = 1 }
			add = { desc = "HEIR_SELECTION_DIP_DESC" value = 1 }
			add = { desc = "HEIR_SELECTION_MIL_DESC" value = 1 }
			add = { desc = "HEIR_SELECTION_APPOINTED_HEIR_DESC" value = 250 }
			add = { desc = "HEIR_SELECTION_BORN_IN_THE_PURPLE_DESC" value = 120 }
			add = { desc = "HEIR_SELECTION_OLDER_HEIR_DESC" value = 1 }
			add = { desc = "HEIR_SELECTION_IS_UNSUITED_TO_RULE_DESC" value = -1000 }
		}
	}
}

# 2. Secret Edict Box Succession (Mimi Jianchu — Golden Casket Meritocratic Designation)
oe_dyn2_secret_edict_box = {
	include_ruler_siblings = yes
	through_female = no
	allow_female = no
	allow_children = yes
	ignore_ruler = yes
	traverse_family_tree = yes

	allowed_estates = { nobles_estate }
	heir_is_allowed = { }

	potential = {
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
		OR = {
			country_rank = country_rank:rank_empire
			has_or_had_tag = CHI
			has_or_had_tag = YUA
			has_or_had_tag = MNG
			has_or_had_tag = MCH
			has_or_had_tag = JEC
			culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:chinese_group }
			culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:jurchen_group }
			has_variable = oe_dyn2_secret_edict_charter
		}
		NOR = {
			succession_law = heir_selection:fratricide_succesion
			succession_law = heir_selection:unigeniture
		}
	}

	allowed = {
		legitimacy >= 60
	}

	modifier = {
		monthly_legitimacy = 0.06
		country_cabinet_efficiency = 0.04
		stability_investment = small_stability_investment
	}

	succession_effect = {
		add_legitimacy = 10
		set_variable = { name = oe_dyn2_edict_unsealed value = 1 years = 10 }
	}

	sibling_score = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = root }
			add = {
				desc = "HEIR_SELECTION_ADM_DESC"
				value = root.adm
			}
			add = {
				desc = "HEIR_SELECTION_ADM_DESC"
				value = root.adm
			}
			add = {
				desc = "HEIR_SELECTION_DIP_DESC"
				value = root.dip
			}
			add = {
				desc = "HEIR_SELECTION_MIL_DESC"
				value = root.mil
			}
			add = {
				desc = "HEIR_SELECTION_APPOINTED_HEIR_DESC"
				if = {
					limit = { has_character_modifier = appoint_as_heir_modifier }
					value = 300
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "HEIR_SELECTION_IS_UNSUITED_TO_RULE_DESC"
				if = {
					limit = { modifier:blocked_from_being_ruler = yes }
					value = -1000
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			add = { desc = "HEIR_SELECTION_ADM_DESC" value = 2 }
			add = { desc = "HEIR_SELECTION_DIP_DESC" value = 1 }
			add = { desc = "HEIR_SELECTION_MIL_DESC" value = 1 }
			add = { desc = "HEIR_SELECTION_APPOINTED_HEIR_DESC" value = 300 }
			add = { desc = "HEIR_SELECTION_IS_UNSUITED_TO_RULE_DESC" value = -1000 }
		}
	}
}
